Fix the source so that the suite passes.

Constraints:
- Do not modify anything under `tests/`.
- Do not add new dependencies; the standard library is all that is available.
- Keep the public API of the `solution` package unchanged: `from_roman`.
summary: I fixed the bug in `solution/core.py`, and the visible suite now passes (3 tests). The value table used `"DCCCC"` for 900 instead of `"CM"`. Because of that, the lookup table built from it never contained `CM`-style numerals, so `from_roman` rejected them. I replaced it with `"CM"`. I didn't touch anything under `tests/`.
